Sprott Continues to Hold Stake in Exxon Mobil (XOM); As Apache (APA) Valuation Declined, Holder Point72 Asset Management LP Decreased Position 
April 23, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Steve Cohen decreased its stake in Apache Corp (APA) by 57.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Point72 Asset Management Lp sold 1.17 million shares as the company’s stock declined 12.65% with the market. The hedge fund run by Steve Cohen held 870,660 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $36.76 million, down from 2.04M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Point72 Asset Management Lp who had been investing in Apache Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $15.63 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.30% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $40.91. About 2.20M shares traded. Apache Corporation (NYSE:APA) has declined 24.62% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.17% the S&P500. 
Eric Sprott increased its stake in Exxon Mobil Corp (XOM) by 6.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sprott Inc bought 5,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.23% with the market. The hedge fund run by Eric Sprott held 81,100 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.78 million, up from 76,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
